# cloudsmith_saml (Resource)

The SAML resource allows the creation and management of SAML Group Sync configurations for a given Cloudsmith organization. SAML Group sync configuration allows for easy mapping of your current AD groups and assign these groups into Cloudsmith teams.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright Cloudsmith Ltd 2026
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "cloudsmith_saml" "my_saml" {
  organization = "my-organization"
  idp_key      = "role"
  idp_value    = "example"
  role         = "Member"
  enabled      = true
  team         = "owners"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `idp_key` (String)
- `idp_value` (String)
- `organization` (String)
- `team` (String)

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether SAML Group Sync is enabled for the organization.
- `role` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `slug_perm` (String)
